headline: If Barcelona want a striker like Julián Álvarez, only a few options match up
description: Barcelona want a No. 9 striker but have been unable to land their first-choice target of Julián Álvarez. Who should they go for instead? And what do the stats tell us?

headline: The 11 best Premier League careers in USMNT history
description: With the Premier League kicking off and several Americans set to play big minutes in 2026-27, ESPN ranks the best careers by U.S. players in the league.

headline: Tottenham agree deal for Man City's Savinho - sources
description: Tottenham have agreed a deal worth up to £85 million ($116m) to sign Savinho from Manchester City, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal want Yildiz as Al Hilal add Martinelli to shortlist
description: Arsenal are looking into the possibility of signing Kenan Yildiz from Juventus. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Curtis Jones' exit means Liverpool have no local players now. Is that a problem?
description: Curtis Jones was the last local lad in this Liverpool squad. But for a club associated with the likes of Steven Gerrard and Jamie Carragher, is that an issue?

headline: Amad Diallo, Antoine Semenyo, Taiwo Awoniyi - 12 African players, and storylines, to watch in the Premier League this season
description: The Premier League's African contingent for the 26-27 season contains established stars, expensive newcomers, young up-and-comers, and journeymen about to embark on the biggest year of their career.
